name: code-split
purpose: The claim-beside-its-code band of a product page: a framed media split whose copy states the claim, with one or two large buttons under it, and whose media is a code sample on the pixelate texture, cut off by the frame's bottom rule. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'code-split', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `media-split`, `code-block` and `button`. One tab draws a filename bar; several draw a tab strip, and a tab that carries an `icon` shows that mark beside its label.
useWhen: When the argument of a product page is a config file or a handler a developer can read, like Functions, Application Accelerator or AI Gateway.
avoidWhen: For a terminal session under a headline → use `cli-terminal`.
For a run of capabilities, each with its own sample, pinned while the page scrolls → use `sticky-scroll-code`.
related: media-split` — the copy-beside-media band this section renders through.
code-block` — the tabbed code sample in the media cell.
bestPractices: Keep the sample short enough to read in the cell; the frame cuts off whatever runs past it.
Give every tab a `code`; a tab without one is skipped.
Use `primaryAction` alone for one destination, and add `secondaryAction` only for a second, distinct one.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the media split as its `h2` and naming its region; the band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: codeTabs
props.doc: The files of the code sample, in order; each is `{ label, value, code, language?, fileName?, fileIcon?, icon? }` where `icon` is a mark drawn beside the tab label. A tab without `code` is skipped.

props.name: copyAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the sample's copy button; empty keeps the code block's own.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: First button under the copy; `{ label, href, trailing?, icon?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: Second, outlined button beside the first; `{ label, href, trailing?, icon?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CodeSplit from '@aziontech/webkit/code-split'

  const codeTabs = [
    {
      label: 'cache-settings.json',
      value: 'cache-settings',
      language: 'json',
      code: '{\n  "cache_settings": {\n    "name": "api-cache",\n    "browser_cache_settings": {\n      "ttl": 60\n    },\n    "cdn_cache_settings": {\n      "ttl": 30\n    },\n    "cache_key": {\n      "query_string": "whitelist",\n      "query_string_fields": ["user_id", "category"],\n      "cookie": "whitelist",\n      "cookie_names": ["session_id", "region"]\n    },\n    "methods": ["GET", "POST", "OPTIONS"],\n    "stale_cache": true\n  }\n}',
      fileName: 'cache-settings.json',
      fileIcon: 'ai ai-json'
    }
  ]

  const primaryAction = {
    label: 'Learn more',
    href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/products/build/applications/application-accelerator/',
    trailing: true
  }
</script>

<template>
  <CodeSplit
    title="From basic caching to advanced acceleration"
    description="Application Accelerator extends Cache with protocol optimizations and advanced cache rules for dynamic content."
    :code-tabs="codeTabs"
    copy-aria-label="Copy the cache settings sample"
    :primary-action="primaryAction"
  />
</template>
